text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office one day, when...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Kawakami Princess says, it's the
most
festive time of the year. To mark
the occassion,
I've given her the day off
so that she can relax
and enjoy herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I saaaid happy holidays! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aren't you going to celebrate the holidays today as well?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You mean only I have the day
off?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what's that all about?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Saying this, she bursts out of my office.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hm, hmmm. ♪
Hm, hm, hmmm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess hums a tune as she
puts up
festive decorations around my
office.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, no matter how hungry you
get,
make sure you don't touch that
pizza. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Your holiday season begins once you've
finished
all your work!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Make sure to work up a big
appetite! I'll
even get us a roast chicken!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I... might not have enough money...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give a teary-eyed Kawakami Princess a
little
holiday cheer in the form of some
allowance.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hm, hmmm.
Hm, hm, hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing at all. I thought that it might
help you
concentrate better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I want to eat together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I finish writing my last report, I
send out one
final email and...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Are you done?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ahh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then let's hurry and eat! We still have
time left
before the day is done!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, don't worry about it! A quick zap
in the
microwave and it'll be piping hot
again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get this party started! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spend a delightfully festive
evening with
Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Then let's head out right away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry—a quick zap in the
microwave and it
will be piping hot
again! C'mon, let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kawakami Princess takes my
hand and
leads me outside...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Schwoop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And before I know it, I find myself facing
the sky.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, isn't it faster being carried in a
princess's
arms? Hold on tight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel the wind rush across my face as
Kawakami
Princess starts to pick up
speed.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! ♪ Lifting you is easy
compared to the
barbell I normally use!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kawakami Princess carries me to
the top
of a hill.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! Isn't the view at night
simply
beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When I first discovered this place, I just
knew it
was the perfect spot to kick off
the festivities!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, indeed. ♪ I think so, too... Hey,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Thank you for all the work you do.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. You're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to my office, we buy a
Princess
Fighter cake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might have been a late start, but I
enjoy a nice,
festive evening with
Kawakami Princess.
